# `Q-12-2` — Inline Listing Contents Not Yet Supported (retired)

> Older Quarto 2 releases skipped inline `contents:` records; current
> releases render them.

## What this means

The `contents:` key of a listing accepts a list of paths or
globs that tell Quarto which documents to include, and it can also
accept *inline records* — objects with fields like `title`, `path`,
`date` — so that a listing can mix real files with hand-written
entries.

Quarto 2 releases after 0.26 support inline records and no longer
emit this code. If you see it, you are on an older release — upgrade,
or move each record to a file until you can.

See the [listings guide](/guides/projects/listings.qmd) for what
inline records accept today.
